text: uh.... -_- so i was painting a model, i then went to add a new plane to it and that plane spawned in not as a plane at all, and so i tried to undo it and it completely fucked all the painting
resolution: Fixed the Paint/Add Part journal collision at all relevant boundaries. Add Primitive now exits Paint before opening its dialog and defensively refuses stale paint-live callers; the host snapshots and restores exact atlas texels, the active atlas base, and the stroke program across append plus add/duplicate/mirror undo-redo; and the plane primitive is pinned as one indexed quad before lowering. Added a framework-layer atlas-carry regression and passed 18 model-paint tests, 9 indexed edit-mesh tests, and the full ReleaseFast editor build. Read-only recovery audit also found the latest he_ad on-disk base paint program and an older explicit Painting 1 variant intact.
